The fixed inverse on U_p need not agree with the inverse selected by an unrelated strictly convex C containing p,q. On the flat four-dimensional cylinder with spatial period 1, W_p=R×(-0.05,0.95)×R² selects displacement 0.9 to q, whereas C with spatial lift (-0.15,0.05) selects -0.1; the C-inverse at q returns 0.1 to p, not -0.9.
